Question
========
Which of the following statements about JSON are correct?

Answerlist
----------
* JSON is a text syntax that is suitable for the interchange of semi-structured data.
* JSON is standardized, among others, in IETF RFC 8259.
* JSON can only be used together with the JavaScript programming language.
* JSON has many parallels to XML.


Solution
========
JSON is a lightweight, text-based syntax designed for exchanging semi-structured data, and it is formally standardized in IETF RFC 8259 as well as ECMA-404. Even though its name comes from JavaScript, it is a language-independent format - it is used from R, Python, Java and many other languages just as easily. It also shares a lot of common ground with XML: both are text-based, hierarchical, and human as well as machine readable.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* True
* False
* True
